image.edit.unsupported: @image: image backend %s does not edit images, so nothing was sent. Editing backends: openai (gpt-image-2.5), openai-responses, xai (grok-imagine), google (Gemini/Nano Banana), bedrock (SD3.5 Large, Stable Image Ultra and the Image Services: inpaint, remove-background, upscale…), sdwebui (img2img), and a CHATCLI_IMAGE_URL server unless CHATCLI_IMAGE_URL_EDITS=false. Switch with @image use {model}, or pin an edit backend with @image use {provider, for: "edit"}.
image.edit.bedrock_model: @image: Bedrock model %s does not edit images, so nothing was sent. Switch with @image use {model}.
